build_sam2_model: build a SAM2Base model with image encoder, memory attention, and memory encoder for video segmentation
run_forward_sam_heads: run the SAM prompt encoder and mask decoder to produce low and high resolution masks with IoU estimates
run_track_step: run a single tracking step on a video frame using memory conditioned features and SAM heads
run_forward_image: run the image encoder on a batch of images to extract backbone features for downstream processing
run_apply_non_overlapping_constraints: run non-overlapping constraints on predicted masks to keep only the highest scoring object at each spatial location
